recovery.accountWarning: This removes this account’s cached data and locally stored encryption key, and forgets the selected server connection’s saved sign-ins and trust pin. Other local accounts and the Zann unlock password stay unchanged. Remote data is unchanged. An encrypted recovery snapshot is saved first.
